statement: Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2024 (resolves on 2027 data). Context: in 2024 the statistics office reported preliminary 2022->2023 annual average productivity growth of 1.2% and a 1.6% annualised rate over the cycle since 2019Q4, both below the 2.5% threshold, though recent quarters ran ~2.3-2.7%.

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office (preliminary): nonfarm business labour productivity rose 3.2% (annualised) in 2023Q4 and 2.7% year on year; annual average productivity rose 1.2% from 2022 to 2023.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Fourth Quarter and Annual Averages 2023, Preliminary (USDL 24-0147), 2024-02-01 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office revised 2023 quarterly and annual productivity data to incorporate updated output and compensation source data.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Fourth Quarter and Annual Averages 2023, Revised, 2024-03-07 (verified via web_extract this run; the revised annual nonfarm figure was not located in the extracted text, so no value is recorded).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office (preliminary): nonfarm business labour productivity rose 2.3% (annualised) in 2024Q2 and 2.7% year on year; since 2019Q4 it has grown at a 1.6% annualised rate.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2024, Preliminary (USDL 24-1570), 2024-08-01 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office's revised Q3 2024 release: nonfarm business labour productivity +2.2% annualised (unrevised), +2.0% over four quarters; unit labour costs revised to +0.8%.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2024, Revised (2024-12-10); read from the Wayback copy of the archive page.
